records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for your question about inviting a teammate last week — your ticket is closed now, and just to confirm, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time (teammates can also be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time).

On the next step: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is usually what makes everything click. Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and your teammate.

Best,
Chidi
